verdict.rationale: Attio's reporting page describes analyzing live data with line, bar, and geospatial charts and combining visualizations into dashboards. Its example metrics include win rate, sales cycle, and stage conversion, so pipeline and conversion reporting happens in-product, with SQL queries against workspace data as another non-spreadsheet route. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party reporting docs beyond marketing copy, explicit evidence of activity-level reports (only 'live data from every conversation' via Ask Attio), clarity on which reporting is tier-gated ('Advanced reporting' appears as a pricing-tier feature), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
